Festive season mein sweets enjoy karna hai? 🍬✨
You don’t have to completely avoid them — portion size and frequency matter.

Here are 5 popular sweets and what to keep in mind:

🥇 Dry Fruit Laddoo — 9/10
Nuts & seeds make it relatively nutrient-dense, but portions still matter.

🥈 Rasgulla — 8/10
Chenna-based and generally less calorie-dense than many ghee-heavy sweets. 1–2 pieces occasionally can fit in.

🥥 Coconut Burfi — 7.5/10
Coconut provides some fibre and healthy fats. Prefer versions with less added sugar.

🥜 Kaju Katli — 7.5/10
Cashews provide healthy fats and some protein, but it’s still calorie-dense and contains added sugar.

🫘 Besan Laddoo — 7/10
Besan provides more protein and fibre than many refined-flour desserts. Homemade, less-sugar versions are a better option.

Remember: You don’t need to fear sweets. Enjoy them mindfully, keep portions small, and maintain a balanced diet. ❤️

Save this reel 📌 for the festive season and share it with someone who loves mithai!
